name: JuaKALI
desc: A web application designed to empower Kenyan artisans by providing a marketplace to showcase and sell their crafts. Built with PHP, MySQL, and Bootstrap, this platform supports user authentication, product management, and artisan-specific features.

name: MemeTik
desc: Memetik is a web-based meme-sharing platform developed by Memes254Ke where users can upload, browse, and interact with Kenyan-themed memes. The project is built using Django and Tailwind CSS.

name: Vidloader
desc: A modern platform and software for downloading videos and audios from famous social media platforms : TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and X. An initial release for the Windows desktop version is already out.

name: UrbanPulse
desc: A modern Kenyan ecommerce platform built with PHP and integrated with mpesa daraja API for Mpesa payments.

name: POS System
desc: A Django-powered point-of-sale system featuring inventory management, sales processing, customer profiles, analytics, and reporting tools.

name: Collins Browser
desc: A simple, professional desktop browser built with PyQt, featuring bookmarks, downloads, history, dark mode, and a modern user-friendly interface.
